1.0.0: Initial native API candidate with managed API-key authentication, entity resolution and bounded transcript search. Full envelopes and coverage preserved; no automatic entity selection or quality fallback.
Advanced MakeApiCall supports explicit GET, POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE requests within Arcmira v1, with managed credentials and unchanged HTTP envelopes. Write methods may modify data.
1.0.1: Fix hosted component loading by validating responses against the complete schema already embedded in each component manifest.
1.0.2: Parse the documented key-value editor JSON-object text for Parameters and Headers while retaining input and managed-authentication checks.
1.0.3: Show the paying personal or team account in managed connection labels, with caller and key context and support for older profiles.
1.0.4: Include top-up credits in usage descriptions and add the Arcmira homepage to the bundled guide. Request behavior is unchanged.
